title: Food Fight Arena — Build
subtitle: 3D rebuild in Three.js, judged against Brawl Stars & Zooba

active.detail: Hamburger is being modelled first and becomes the art bible for the other ten. Reference stills are being cropped into clean, text-free A/B plates in parallel.

pieces.name: Frozen design spec
pieces.note: All 11 characters, every weapon, all balance numbers

pieces.name: Render core
pieces.note: Toon ramps, inverted-hull outline, 3-point rig, AgX + bloom + SMAA

pieces.name: Screenshot pipeline
pieces.note: Headless WebGL verified producing real pixels

pieces.name: Blind A/B compositor
pieces.note: Shuffles ours/reference into A and B; key held separately

pieces.name: Reference imagery
pieces.note: 30 full-res stills pulled; cropping to clean plates

pieces.name: Hamburger
pieces.note: Sets the art direction for the whole cast

pieces.name: Kitchen arena
pieces.note: Bigger, denser; hazard + cover + slow zone preserved

pieces.name: Ability VFX
pieces.note: Projectiles, melee arcs, splats, trails, giant slam

notes: The game design is frozen. Damage, cooldowns, ranges, speeds and match structure are transcribed verbatim from the 2D prototype and must not be retuned.
The arena is the one sanctioned exception — layout and props are open, as long as a central hazard, physical cover and a slowing hazard survive.
Every piece is judged on rendered pixels in a blind A/B against real Brawl Stars and Zooba stills, never on a description of the work.
